WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT tr.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tx.trdref) AS ref_count
  FROM transactionrecord AS tx
  JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref
  GROUP BY tr.tradekind
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(ref_count) AS total_count
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT s1.tradekind, s1.ref_count,
         1.0 * s1.ref_count / NULLIF(s2.total_count, 0) AS share
  FROM step1 AS s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 AS s2
  WHERE s2.total_count IS NOT NULL
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(ref_count) AS avg_count
  FROM step3
)
SELECT s3.tradekind, s3.ref_count, s3.share,
       s3.ref_count - s4.avg_count AS difference
FROM step3 AS s3
CROSS JOIN step4 AS s4
WHERE s4.avg_count IS NOT NULL
  AND s3.ref_count > s4.avg_count
